html.content:
Recommended

Barscore: 0.95

Vertical or horizontal bars comparing values across categories.

Clinical use: AE counts by SOC/arm, subject counts by group

  • 1+ category + 1+ numeric
  • small-medium dataset
  • manageable category count

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='grouped bar chart of <metric> by <category>'

Alternatives

Stackedscore: 0.9

Stacked bars showing part-of-whole within each group.

Clinical use: AE severity breakdown per arm, disposition categories

  • 2+ categories ideal for stacking
  • few stack levels

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='stacked bar of <metric> by <category>'

Heatmapscore: 0.9

Color-coded matrix — rows × columns with optional clustering and dendrograms.

Clinical use: AE incidence by SOC × arm, gene expression heatmap

  • 2 cats as row/col + numeric value

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='heatmap of <numeric> with <factor1> rows and <factor2> columns'

DotLinescore: 0.9

Forest-plot style: horizontal CI lines with central estimate dot.

Clinical use: Hazard ratios, odds ratios, risk differences

  • cat + numeric — possible forest plot

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='forest plot of <estimate> with CI by <factor>'

StackedPercentscore: 0.85

100% stacked bars — each bar sums to 100%.

Clinical use: Relative AE severity distribution across arms

  • 2+ cats → proportion comparison
  • few stack segments

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='100% stacked bar of <metric> by <category>'
